records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Timber Studio!
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: First project hit on signup day and one invite sent (slack:8efe1e07) show early momentum, but no key_milestone in 6 days and no customer activity since. Open ticket (tick_5a944ac39620) says Maya is out next week, reducing odds of self-driven activation in the 8 remaining days.

draft.subject: Your second admin question — and a quick hand
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for your note about backup coverage — your ticket is still open on our side, and I wanted to answer directly: a second admin can be added from Account Settings any time, so you can get cover in place before you're out.

Since you've already created your first project and brought a teammate in, the natural next step is getting real work moving inside that project. Would a 15-minute call this week help? I can walk through it with you and your new admin together so nothing stalls while you're away.

Best,
Priya
